controls.procedure: Before terminal publication, compare the fresh remote head lineage and changed paths with the material SHA and result-only allowlist recorded by the previous certificate; exercise a material-path drift case.
controls.expected: Any post-certificate material path or non-certified parent forces post-write-refreeze before a new handoff can be published.
controls.observed: The literal stale-candidate classification and two independent transfer surfaces all enforced the refreeze lower bound; a fresh exact-head package is required for the current material candidate.
